newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 995.65.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 995.65.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 0.43 centavos lower at 995.65 after a day of quiet trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet and there were very few trades," one dealer said in a telephone interview.

He said there was still considerable confusion over measures the central bank announced Friday aimed at ensuring the peso will devalue by at least 15 percent next year, and that many market players were holding to the sidelines.

Dealers reported 196 trades for a total of $128 million and said the peso's low for the day was 995.90. The central bank intervened by buying small quantities of dollars when the peso hit its intra-day high 995.57, at the top of its daily floating rate exchange band, dealers said.
